history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A close-up, eye-level shot focuses on the right side of a young person's face and shoulder, as they are in the process of washing their face. A beige towel with a textured pattern and yellow trim is draped over their head and behind their ear, partially obscuring their dark, wet hair. White facial cleanser foam is spread unevenly across their cheek, with some circular motions visible, suggesting they are lathering it. Their right eye is visible, looking slightly off-camera, with a hint of a tear or water droplet near the corner. The lighting is soft and diffused, highlighting the texture of the foam and the skin. The background is a blur of muted colors, with hints of a light blue wall and a shelf or surface with a geometric pattern in shades of yellow and white. A glimpse of a blue object, possibly a container, is visible in the lower left corner. The mood is intimate and candid, capturing a moment of personal grooming. The color palette is dominated by skin tones, white foam, beige and yellow of the towel, and the soft blues and yellows in the background. The overall aesthetic is realistic and naturalistic.
